scripts.db-deploy: railway run npx sequelize-cli --env=production db:migrate:undo:all && railway run npx sequelize-cli --env=production db:migrate && railway run npx sequelize-cli --env=production db:seed:all
scripts.db-start: npx sequelize db:drop && npx sequelize db:create && npx sequelize db:migrate && npx sequelize db:seed:all
scripts.db-test: npx sequelize-cli --env=test db:drop && npx sequelize-cli --env=test db:create && npx sequelize-cli --env=test db:migrate
scripts.package: npm i pg express sequelize bcryptjs jsonwebtoken cors cloudinary dotenv multer sharp && npm i -D nodemon sequelize-cli jest supertest
